description.en-US: A small private repository of productivity apps, built and published directly from source by their own developer. No ads, no analytics, no third-party trackers -- just APKs you can install and get automatic updates for through F-Droid.

summary.en-US: Offline-first flashcards for language learning, with TTS and speaking practice

description.en-US:
NLL Engine is a self-contained flashcard app for learning a foreign language, built around spaced repetition so review time goes toward the cards you're actually struggling with rather than everything equally.

The app runs its own local server on your device and works entirely offline for studying, reviewing, and managing your decks. An internet connection is only needed for the optional cloud features described below, and only while you're actively using them.

*Study and review*

* Spaced-repetition scheduling: each card tracks its own ease and interval, so due cards resurface at the right time instead of on a fixed schedule.
* Organize cards into decks and subdecks, with support for bulk-importing whole decks from plain text.
* A speaking quiz mode that listens to your pronunciation and checks it against the card's target text.

*Audio, with a choice of engines*

* On-device text-to-speech, so basic playback needs no network connection at all.
* Optional cloud voices (gTTS, ElevenLabs, Google Cloud TTS, Gemini) for higher-quality or additional-language audio, each requiring only your own API key where applicable -- nothing is bundled or proxied through a third party.
* Speech recognition for the speaking quiz prefers on-device, offline language packs when they're installed, and falls back to an online recognizer otherwise.

*Deck library*

* Bundle your own decks with the app for a fully offline library, or point the app at an online source (a plain folder of a manifest file plus deck/audio files, no special server required) to browse and fetch community decks on demand.

*Backup*

* Optional Google Drive sync lets you back up and restore your study data across devices, using your own Google account -- entirely opt-in, and off by default.

*Privacy*

No accounts, ads, or analytics of any kind. Your decks and study data stay on your device unless you explicitly turn on Drive sync. Any cloud TTS/STT service you choose to enable talks directly to that service using your own credentials -- nothing passes through a server run by this project.
